summary: Round 40 plan check. This was a light round: local reads only, 0 Kaggle calls, done at 13:15-13:20Z. Everything armed in round 39 is alive and matches its logged text: pre_exp89t 17:40Z, the T7 trigger, manual-admit 19:44:45Z, the exp89t watcher, the watchdog, and the 14:13-18:13Z hourly timers plus the 18:37/19:43/21:05/00:07Z timers. The laptop is on AC. The poller cadence is 601.5 s, so it projects headers at ~19:10:06Z and ~19:20:07Z; T7 therefore fires ~19:20Z, as planned. The ~19:40:10Z header comes before 19:44:30Z, so manual-admit runs unless exp89t is already terminal. The user ticked П3 {exp87a, #37} at 12:37:31Z, and that passes the R39-A4 comparator. So the 18:37Z/19:43Z/21:05Z checks push only after an exp89t promotion. I found four actionable items and no rule rewrites. (1) The feed loop runs at ~18:59:28Z, which is inside the R39-A6 (2) window of 0 agent calls between 17:30Z and 20:00Z. That run makes ~35 calls in ~8 s, with up to 6 retries each, and the loop is not on the list of jobs allowed to call Kaggle then. Stop it after the ~17:29Z run. (2) The 12:59Z submit-by times for the reserve slot leave out the copy + dummy gate (~35-45 min) and the time to get the user's yes. So the reserve slot is effectively dead for an x138-family E10 file after ~14:10Z (17:10 MSK): CI already now, non-CI then. The next feed E10 check (~14:29Z) already comes too late. Say this to the user in one line and log it. (3) mk_card_1837.py is still not built (R39-A7, deadline 17:40Z). Because the user has already ticked П3, it can shrink to three variants under SELECTED case (a). (4) The round-prompt KEY FACTS and plan-check boilerplate are stale: '{#37, #38} ticked', '17th of 21', 'Slot 2 = UNUSED', 'E10 > 0.956'. External: 744250 (Chris Deotte, 12:57Z) says 'It must finish before 23:59 UTC, otherwise it is not eligible nor can we select it.' 744273 has comments but no knobs; E10 FLAG none; best public 0.953. Nothing to build.

findings.what: The feed loop breaks the R39-A6 (2) rule of 0 agent calls between 17:30Z and 20:00Z. run_feed_loop.sh sleeps 5400 s after each ~7-8 s run. From the log ends (09:58:41 -> 11:28:49 -> 12:58:56Z, 5407-5408 s per cycle), the next runs start ~14:29:04, ~15:59:12, ~17:29:20Z (it finishes seconds before 17:30), ~18:59:28Z and ~20:29:36Z. The ~18:59Z run is inside the window. It falls in the exp89t read tail (CI L up to 9.48 h = 18:29Z typical, tail to ~19:54Z), the T3 lag re-save and download retries (last start 19:40Z), and just before the single-attempt 19:44:45Z manual-admit list. One run is ~1 search + 16 x (get_topic + list_comments) + the kernel list, about 35 calls in ~8 s. kaggle_feed._retry retries up to 6 times on errors, which multiplies the calls under a 429. R39-A6 (2) lists only the poller, pre_exp89t, the watcher save, manual_admit and the SELECTED reads as callers in that window, so the feed loop is not covered. After ~14:10Z (see PC40-02), an E10 flag from the feed can no longer be acted on. Separately, the e10-signal waiter (w20284) greps experiments/e10_watch/watch_loop.log, and that loop ended at 12:00Z, so the waiter is dead weight.

findings.action: Once the ~17:29Z run has written its feed_loop.log line (check at the 17:13Z round, or with a local wait until the log has a line stamped >= 17:29Z), stop the loop: kill the bash loop w20892 and its 'sleep 5400' child, using Stop-Process on the winpids after reading them fresh with /proc/<pid>/winpid. Kill the e10-signal waiter w20284 as well. Leave the FEED SIGNAL waiter w24352 alone; it simply never fires. If host announcements are wanted after the tick, run one 'python tools/kaggle_feed.py --topics 12 --no-kernels' by hand at >= 20:05Z (the 21:05Z timer can do it). Log one CONTEXT line: 'feed loop stopped after the 17:29Z run (R39-A6 (2) window; ~35 calls/run with 6x retry); host notices via Chrome in rounds 44-45 and one manual run after 20:05Z'. This is an ops change only, not a rule change.

findings.what: The 12:59Z entry gives submit-by times for the reserve slot (744250 finish-by-23:59Z): '~14:30-15:00Z non-CI / ~13:15Z CI'. It takes these from L_hi alone. It leaves out three lead times. First, the copy + dummy gate: RULE v2.1 whole-kernel <= 2,100 s, and the exp89t dummy took 1,984 s, so ~35-45 min. Second, the single verification call and the user's explicit yes, which R38-A2 (d) requires. Third, the feed only checks every 90 min, and its next E10 look is ~14:29Z. With those included, the last useful moment to START an E10 copy is ~12:30Z for CI (already past) and ~14:10Z (17:10 MSK) for non-CI using the pool limit L_hi <= 9.0 h. Using the observed L of an x138-verbatim file (exp56, 6.29-6.46 h), the physical submit limit is ~17:00Z, but that file would then finish ~23:30Z, just before the cutoff. Every such file reads after the user's 23:00 MSK tick, so it could only become a final through a re-tick between 23:00 and 02:59 MSK. The user said 'держим его в запасе' at ~11:56Z, possibly expecting the slot to stay usable into the evening.
